title: Secret stores
subtitle: Connect an external secret store (HashiCorp Vault) and inject its values into your apps at deploy time. Values are never stored in Tugra.
name: Name
addressHttpWarn: This address uses http:// — the token would be sent unencrypted.
tokenHint: Vault token with read access to the KV v2 paths you will reference. It is verified, encrypted and never shown again.
tokenKeep: Leave blank to keep the current token.
tokenRequiredOnAddressChange: Enter the access token again when changing the store address.
deleteBlockedInUse: Remove the app secrets that use this store first.
empty: Connect Vault to pull database passwords and API keys into apps without pasting them into Tugra.
proHint: External secret stores are a Pro feature. Activate a license under Settings to connect one.
